name: Butter Chicken Curry
description: A rich and creamy Indian curry that's perfect for a weeknight dinner.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a large bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, and chili powder.
Add chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

instructions.title: Prepare the Sauce
steps: Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute more.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.

instructions.title: Cook the Chicken
steps: Add marinated chicken to the sauce.
Simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro before serving.

notes: Serve with basmati rice and naan bread for a complete meal.

name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
description: The authentic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, pancetta and black pepper.

instructions.title: Prepare Ingredients
steps: Cut the pancetta into small cubes.
Grate both cheeses and mix them together.
In a bowl, whisk eggs and egg yolk with half the cheese mixture.

instructions.title: Cook Pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water before draining.

instructions.title: Make the Sauce
steps: While pasta is cooking, sauté pancetta in a large pan until crisp.
Turn off heat under the pancetta.
Add drained pasta to the pancetta pan and toss quickly.
Quickly pour in egg mixture, stirring continuously.
Add a splash of reserved pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
Add remaining cheese and black pepper.
Serve immediately.

notes: The key to carbonara is to work quickly to ensure the eggs create a creamy sauce without scrambling.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: A fragrant and spicy Thai curry with coconut milk, vegetables and your choice of protein.

instructions.title: Prepare Ingredients
steps: Cut chicken or tofu into bite-sized pieces.
Slice bell peppers and eggplant.

instructions.title: Cook the Curry
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add green curry paste and fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chicken/tofu and stir to coat with paste.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add vegetables, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
Simmer until chicken is cooked and vegetables are tender, about 10-15 minutes.

instructions.title: Finish the Dish
steps: Stir in Thai basil leaves and lime leaves.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.

notes: For a vegetarian version, use tofu and substitute soy sauce for fish sauce.

name: Classic French Crêpes
description: Thin, delicate French pancakes that can be filled with sweet or savory ingredients.

instructions.title: Make the Batter
steps: In a blender, combine all ingredients and blend until smooth.
Let the batter rest in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.

instructions.title: Cook the Crêpes
steps: Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Lightly butter the pan.
Pour about 1/4 cup of batter into the center of the pan, then quickly tilt to spread into a thin layer.
Cook until edges are golden and top looks dry (about 1 minute).
Flip and cook for another 30 seconds.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.

instructions.title: Serve
steps: Fill with your choice of sweet fillings like Nutella, jam, or fresh fruit.
Alternatively, use savory fillings like ham and cheese.
Fold or roll crêpes around filling.

notes: Letting the batter rest allows gluten to relax, resulting in more tender crêpes.

name: Mexican Guacamole
description: Fresh and flavorful avocado dip that's perfect for parties or as a topping.

instructions.title: Prepare Ingredients
steps: Dice the red onion, tomatoes, and jalapeño.
Finely chop the cilantro and mince the garlic.
Cut the lime in half.

instructions.title: Make the Guacamole
steps: Cut avocados in half, remove pits, and scoop out flesh into a bowl.
Mash the avocados with a fork, leaving some chunks for texture.
Squeeze lime juice over the mashed avocados to prevent browning.
Add diced onion, tomatoes, jalapeño, garlic, and cilantro.
Mix gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions.title: Serve
steps: Serve immediately with tortilla chips.
If not serving right away, press plastic wrap directly onto the surface to prevent browning.

notes: For extra flavor, you can add a pinch of ground cumin.

name: Japanese Teriyaki Chicken
description: Juicy chicken glazed with sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, a Japanese classic.

instructions.title: Prepare the Sauce
steps: In a bowl, mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and brown sugar.
Grate garlic and ginger and add to the sauce mixture.
Set aside half of the sauce for glazing later.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
steps: Place chicken thighs in a ziplock bag.
Pour half of the sauce over the chicken.
Seal the bag and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, or up to overnight.

instructions.title: Cook the Chicken
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Remove chicken from marinade and pat dry with paper towels.
Cook chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Remove chicken and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

instructions.title: Make the Glaze
steps: Pour the reserved sauce into the pan and bring to a simmer.
Mix cornstarch and water to make a slurry.
Add slurry to the sauce and stir until thickened.
Return sliced chicken to the pan and coat with the glaze.
Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.

notes: Serve with steamed rice and vegetables for a complete meal.

name: Greek Moussaka
description: A traditional Greek casserole with layers of eggplant, potatoes, and spiced meat topped with a creamy béchamel sauce.

instructions.title: Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Slice eggplants into 1/2 inch rounds, salt them, and let sit for 30 minutes to draw out moisture.
Rinse eggplant slices and pat dry.
Thinly slice potatoes.
Brush eggplant and potato slices with olive oil and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes until soft.

instructions.title: Make the Meat Sauce
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan and sauté the onion until soft.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add ground meat and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, red wine, cinnamon, and allspice.
Simmer for 20-30 minutes until thickened. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions.title: Make the Béchamel Sauce
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth and thickened.
Add nutmeg and season with salt and pepper.
Remove from heat, let cool slightly, then whisk in eggs and parmesan.

instructions.title: Assemble and Bake
steps: In a 9x13 inch baking dish, layer potato slices, then half the eggplant slices.
Spread the meat sauce evenly over the eggplant.
Layer the remaining eggplant slices on top of the meat sauce.
Pour the béchamel sauce over everything and smooth the top.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45-50 minutes until golden brown on top.
Let rest for 15-20 minutes before serving.

notes: Make ahead and reheat for even better flavor.

name: Korean Bibimbap
description: A colorful Korean rice bowl topped with vegetables, protein, and a spicy gochujang sauce.

instructions.title: Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Julienne the carrots and zucchini.
Blanch the spinach for 1 minute, then rinse with cold water and squeeze out excess moisture.
Boil bean sprouts for 2-3 minutes, then drain.
Slice mushrooms and sauté until tender.
Season each vegetable separately with salt, garlic, and sesame oil.

instructions.title: Prepare the Meat
steps: Marinate ground beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, and minced garlic.
Cook in a pan until browned and cooked through.

instructions.title: Make the Sauce
steps: Mix gochujang, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sesame oil, sugar, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.

instructions.title: Fry the Eggs
steps: Fry eggs sunny-side up, keeping the yolks runny.

instructions.title: Assemble the Bibimbap
steps: Place warm rice in individual bowls.
Arrange the vegetables and meat in separate sections on top of the rice.
Place a fried egg in the center of each bowl.
Serve with the gochujang sauce on the side.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds before eating.
Mix everything together thoroughly before eating.

notes: You can customize with your favorite vegetables and proteins.
